identity.summary: Real operator; Econ Healthcare (Asia) Pte. Ltd. (formerly SGX Catalist-listed Econ Healthcare (Asia) Limited), founded 1987 by Ong Chu Poh; taken private by TPG (CCCS review 2025); now under One Aged Care holding (Mar 2026).
identity.how_openserp_helped: Search surfaced regulator, company and TPG pages; extraction clean.
identity.what_was_missing: Exact current legal registration (ACRA) not checked.

business_and_headcount.summary: 8 nursing homes/medicare centres in Singapore plus Malaysia and China sites (company page); also home care, day care, rehab, TCM. One Aged Care: 16 nursing homes, >2,400 beds across SG and MY. Headcount not found.
business_and_headcount.what_was_missing: Staff headcount; annual report PDF extract returned binary garbage.

financial_performance.summary: FY2024 (to Mar 2024): revenue S$50.8m (+18%), net income about S$6.3m; 1H FY2025 revenue S$32.7m (+33.7%), earnings S$3.6m (search snippets). Privatised by TPG at about S$88m valuation.
financial_performance.what_was_missing: No post-privatisation financials (private now); figures from snippets, not page-verified.

layoffs_restructuring.summary: No layoffs found. Restructuring: TPG consolidated ECON, Orange Valley and AMS under One Aged Care (Mar 2026). Absence of layoff news is weak evidence.
layoffs_restructuring.how_openserp_helped: Search for layoffs returned no relevant hits.
layoffs_restructuring.what_was_missing: Searching negatives is unreliable; first layoff query drifted to unrelated results.

culture_and_sentiment.summary: Jobstreet summary: career development, supportive colleagues, incentives/trips; negatives: slow decisions (family business), overtime/night duty, limited promotion, heavy admin. Glassdoor snippet: 25% recommend, 1.7/5 work-life balance (snippet only, unread). Jobstreet shows only 7 reviews.
culture_and_sentiment.how_openserp_helped: Surfaced review-site pages and snippets; Jobstreet summary extractable.
culture_and_sentiment.what_was_missing: Individual reviews; Glassdoor page not extracted successfully; small sample.

pay_and_benefits.summary: Indeed snippet: monthly salary about S$2,641 (Nurse) to S$6,082 (Senior Nurse Manager) from 45 postings; a Glassdoor snippet gave S$3,200 average staff nurse (period unclear). Benefits: Jobstreet cites incentives, awards, trips.
pay_and_benefits.what_was_missing: Reliable staff nurse range; official benefits list; MyCareersFuture job page extracted nearly empty.

interview_and_hiring.how_openserp_helped: Search surfaced careers and job-listing pages only.

red_flags_and_scams.summary: No scams, regulatory action or court cases found in one targeted search (results irrelevant). Low Glassdoor work-life balance score is a soft flag.
red_flags_and_scams.what_was_missing: Targeted MOH enforcement/news search came back with noise.

recent_news.summary: TPG offer Feb 2025; CCCS review Sep-Oct 2025 with no major competition concerns; One Aged Care launched 17 Mar 2026 with Ong Hui Ming as Group CEO.

blocked_or_unreadable_sites: SIAS annual-report Q&A PDF (HTTP 200, binary garbage)
misleading_or_wrong_results: Pay snippet for Glassdoor says 'per year' for a monthly figure
Company pages disagree on facility counts (7 vs 8 vs 9 in SG)

verdict.reasoning: Strong on identity, ownership and news; weak on sentiment depth, pay detail and interviews because review sites are mostly seen only as snippets.
